local_CPU_contract.conditions: Each local instruction effect requires the observed encoding to be reached and complete fault-free under the x86-32 interpretation. This is static evidence, not execution or reachability proof.
local_CPU_contract.widths_and_segments: No instruction has an explicit operand/address/segment prefix. Explicit memory operands are dword: no-base 0109E170 defaults to current DS; EBP-4 defaults to current SS. Implicit stack accesses use current SS. These defaults do not authenticate live selector/base/limit attributes.
local_CPU_contract.stack_condition: Every ESP equation additionally assumes an actual 32-bit SS stack-address size at that point. Operand width and decoder mode do not establish SS.B. After every opaque call this condition must be imposed anew; a 16-bit stack uses SP semantics.
local_CPU_contract.entry_prefix: With entry ESP=T and actual 32-bit SS stack, PUSH imm8 sign-extends 08 to dword8 and stores at SS:[T-4]. PUSH imm32 stores 00E03578 at SS:[T-8]. E8 at C07AC8 writes encoded return C07ACD at SS:[T-12] and transfers numerically to C07C00. Neither immediate has a proved pointer/type identity.
local_CPU_contract.first_resumed_region: If C07ACD is reached after an opaque return, its current registers/segments/memory are fresh unknown state. PUSH dword DS:[0109E170] samples that current dword and writes it to the then-current stack. The E8 at C07AD3 targets C04FDE and encodes return C07AD8. No data at 0109E170 was queried and no global/TLS/provider meaning is inferred.
local_CPU_contract.after_second_call: At any resumed C07AD8 all state is again unconstrained. With actual 32-bit SS stack and current ESP=U, POP ECX reads current SS:[U] and leaves ESP=U+4. This does not establish argument cleanup or earlier stack identity.
local_CPU_contract.local_condition: TEST EAX,EAX leaves EAX unchanged, sets ZF iff current EAX is zero, SF to its bit31, PF to even parity of its low byte, clears CF/OF and leaves AF undefined. If the adjacent JZ uses those flags, zero selects C07AF3; otherwise it falls through to C07ADD.
local_CPU_contract.nonzero_local_path: AND dword SS:[EBP-4],0 is a current-memory read-modify-write of zero, not a write-only store. It requires the memory access and sets ZF/PF, clears SF/CF/OF, leaves AF undefined. It does not change EAX. A reached CALL EAX at C07AE1 uses its instruction-time EAX as numeric target and encodes return C07AE3. No target was queried.
local_CPU_contract.after_indirect_call: At any resumed C07AE3 every register including EBP/ESP, all segments, flags and memory is unconstrained. JMP rel8 targets C07AEC across the unqueried seven-byte gap. MOV at C07AEC writes dword FFFFFFFE to current SS:[EBP-4]; this need not be the earlier AND address and proves no EH-state or frame identity.
local_CPU_contract.outbound_transfer: E9 at C07AF3 transfers numerically to C07A75 without a return-address push. Its saved CALL_RETURN annotation supplies no physical CALL opcode or target nonreturn evidence. No RET appears in the admitted bytes, which does not establish whether an outbound target can return.
local_CPU_contract.opaque_calls: Every direct or indirect callee may change every returned register, EBP, ESP, segment, EFLAGS and memory. No callee preservation, original ABI, convention, cleanup or stability is assumed. Current-memory reads/writes are separate samples; aliasing prevents substituting prior values.
local_CPU_contract.semantic_limit: Saved _inconsistency, __SEH_prolog4, BSP_CRT_DecodePointerCurrentState and terminate labels and their saved flags are metadata only. No service, EH/FH3/TLS/type identity, provider, independence or whole-function behavior is authenticated.
